# Skill Learning (Retired)

This unregistered legacy entrypoint is retained only as a fail-closed tombstone.
It returns `legacy_skill_learning_retired_use_cstar_forge` and performs no
prompting, source access, installation, or writes.

New skill implementation follows the active CStar lifecycle and durable
`cstar_forge_request -> cstar_forge_execute` route.
